messages:
anya: Heads-up — my ceiling fan started making this weird chirp and it ended up being on the mic during standup
mike: oh no :grimacing: did you switch to the headset?
lina: ugh those tiny resonances are the worst, sometimes turning off 'original sound' helps
anya: tried that, and noise suppression, still a pulsing whine when the blades hit a certain speed. here's a clip: https://files.redwood.example/fan-clip.mp3
jamal: quick hack — place a folded towel on the grill (careful of airflow) or dampen the laptop feet with rubber to change resonance
mike: also try moving the mic a bit off-axis from the fan, directionality helps
larga: wait whoa — random name typo ignore
lina: also check for a loose screw on the fan mount, vibration travels into the floor and into desks sometimes
anya: already checked screws, it's the motor hum. Plan B is moving my desk away from the fan tomorrow. Fun Monday.
mike: want me to swing by with my spare USB mic?
anya: maybe! if you're in the area that would save me from shouting in meetings :sweat_smile:
jamal: PSA: my upstairs neighbor's aquarium pump once caused periodic packet loss, so if you move desk near the window watch for new interference
anya: noted. also contractor left a ladder across the porch and UPS left a big box there. Almost tripped over it this AM — posted a pic in the thread: https://img.redwood.example/porch-box.jpg
infra-bot: Speedtest result for anya-home-5G: 185 Mbps down / 12 Mbps up / 21 ms latency
lina: not bad. small poll: which WFH backup do you prefer when audio fails — react with 1/2/3: (1) laptop + headset, (2) phone hotspot + mobile, (3) commandeer partner's office
jamal: 1
anya: 2
mike: 1
lina: 3 :joy:
anya: thanks everyone for tips and the moral support. special shoutout to @jamal for letting me borrow his noise-cancelling mic earlier — lifesaver :raised_hands:
mike: :clap:
jamal: anytime, glad it helped
